assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The submitted site and key-area polygons are repository-provided provisional constraints rather than official redlines.
assumptions.impact: Spatial calculations and figures are suitable for intake discussion only and must be recomputed when official polygons become available.

assumptions.statement: The current smoke-v1 campaign uses three synthetic spatial units, eight matched random worlds, one accessibility intervention, and one no-inertia ablation.
assumptions.impact: The results test software and mechanism direction; they do not estimate real Haidian redevelopment probabilities, land values, or implementation effects.

assumptions.statement: Local household, firm, building-age, rent, OD, traffic-count, exposure, service-capacity, and historical transition datasets have not been assembled and calibrated.
assumptions.impact: Unimplemented or uncalibrated modules remain proposal methods and future qualification work, not empirical claims.

assumptions.statement: AequilibraE is planned as a selected-scenario assignment oracle after a fast surrogate is implemented and observed OD/capacity inputs are available.
assumptions.impact: The current evidence package contains no calibrated traffic assignment or ridership forecast.
